title: The White Gold Rush: The Global Struggle for Sustainable Lithium
subtitle: An examination of the environmental, economic, and geopolitical tensions defining the transition to green energy.
description: Lithium is the cornerstone of the modern electric vehicle revolution, but its extraction carries significant human and environmental costs. This series explores the complex trade-offs between climate goals and local sustainability.

articles.label: Part 1
articles.note: Explaining why lithium is essential for the energy transition and how the demand has surged.

articles.label: Part 2
articles.note: Identifying the key actors: mining corporations, local governments, and indigenous communities.

articles.label: Part 3
articles.note: The conflict between water usage in arid regions and the need for battery minerals.

articles.label: Part 4
articles.note: How supply chain volatility affects prices and the transition speed for consumers.

articles.label: Part 5
articles.note: Unresolved questions: recycling, alternative battery chemistries, and circular economy policies.
